search_youcom_basic: search You.com YDC Index API with a query and api key to get web results
search_youcom_with_filter: search You.com with a domain filter list to restrict results to specific domains
search_youcom_language: search You.com with a specific language code to get localized web results
build_snippet_from_result: build a combined snippet string from a You.com result description and snippets list
refactor_search_youcom: refactor search_youcom to support additional You.com API parameters or response fields
